citation.title: Metabolomic and hemodynamic responses to a single session of mild dynamic exercise in normobaric hypoxia and normoxia in healthy young adults

population.description: Thirteen healthy, non-smoking, leisure-time-active men (Methods: healthy, aged 20-40 y, no cardiovascular, metabolic or respiratory disease, no medication; preliminary medical examination); age 29.7 +/- 4.5 y and BMI 23.5 +/- 1.4 kg/m2 from Table 1 (mean +/- SD). Enrolment age range is a criterion, so min and max are null. Only the normoxia (NORMO) test of the crossover is entered.

protocols.name: normo_bout
protocols.description: NORMO test (FiO2 21%): seated 4 min rest (minutes 0-3), 3 min constant-load cycling at 30% of Wmax (minutes 4-6), 6 min recovery (minutes 7-12); 13 min in all (Methods, Experimental trials). Sampling minutes by the end-of-minute convention: Pre = last minute of rest = 3; Exe3 (after three minutes of exercise) = last exercise minute = 6; Rec3 = minute 9; Rec6 = minute 12. Intensity derived, not printed: no VO2 is printed for the bout, so level = watts/186 with watts = 30% x mean Wmax 255.4 W (Table 1) = 76.62 W; 76.62/186 = 0.4119. Activity segment 4 to 7 so the sample at minute 6 falls with the input on. Test done in the morning about 2 h 30 min after a light breakfast whose content is not printed: no meal is entered and the arm starts from typical values (norm_center, assumed); the clock hour is not printed (8.0 assumed). Mask on a hypoxic gas generator delivering 21% O2 (normal air), so no hypoxia input.

protocols.name: rest_table1
protocols.description: Resting heart rate and blood pressure of the participants' table (Table 1), which does not say when, or after what food, they were measured: entered as a short arm from typical values (norm_center, assumed) with no meal and no activity, sample at minute 15 of a 31-min arm (arm length, sample time and the 8.0 clock hour assumed).
